item_short_desc: Rothco’s Pocket Size Survival Kit is an essential companion for any outdoor adventure or emergency situation, packed with crucial tools in a compact and portable tin. The kit includes everything you need to handle a wide range of survival tasks, from starting a fire with the magnesium fire starter to navigating with the built-in compass. Additional tools like a fishing set, a stainless steel fingertip saw, and a copper line help you secure food or build shelters when needed.
description: Rothco’s Pocket Size Survival Kit is an essential companion for any outdoor adventure or emergency situation, packed with crucial tools in a compact and portable tin. The kit includes everything you need to handle a wide range of survival tasks, from starting a fire with the magnesium fire starter to navigating with the built-in compass. Additional tools like a fishing set, a stainless steel fingertip saw, and a copper line help you secure food or build shelters when needed. The kit also features 2 stainless steel blades for cutting, a whistle for signaling, and first aid items like adhesive strips and a wound pad for minor injuries. Lightweight and easy to carry, this survival kit fits comfortably in your pocket or backpack, ensuring you're always prepared. Whether you're a beginner prepper or an experienced outdoor enthusiast, Rothco’s survival kit provides peace of mind and readiness for any unexpected situation.
